I told Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team that the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats.

Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Hollis is a member of the channel, so he could already see it there. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the Central team. I only read #central-team for this.
